channel.title: Read Tabs, Play Guitar — by Fretbox
channel.description: Guitar tab and notation, one step at a time: how the strings and frets are named, how to read tablature and its symbols, the standard notation that comes with tab, the fretboard, open chords, scales and how to practise with tabs. Every episode ends with practice you can do with your guitar. From Fretbox, the tab player for Guitar Pro and MusicXML files. Narrated with a synthetic voice.
channel.itunes:author: PDEVELOP

item.title: Scales, and practising with tabs
item.description:

Sources: - Guitar Pro, home page (tablature editor and reader, by Arobas Music): https://www.guitar-pro.com/ - free ebook “Read Tabs, Play Guitar”, chapters used in this episode
